scientific_integrity: Finite numerical checks supplement a complete symbolic proof. Source comparison is documented and qualified; no independent certification or authorship is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge pineapple graphs with one common pendant attachment vertex only; m>=3,n>=2. The m=2 star boundary is known and not claimed as original. Weighted paths, multiple attachment hubs and optimal nonisometric distortions are not treated. Historical priority may be incomplete; no independent mathematical validation.
title: Sharp negative-type exponents of pineapple graph metrics and a universal leaf asymptotic
